reasons.organic_shape: Cell boundaries interlock organically, though borders appear slightly too thick and doughy.
reasons.translucency: Materials appear largely opaque and clay-like, missing glassy subsurface scattering.
reasons.lighting_depth: Depth of field is functional, but backlighting and rim highlights remain muted.
reasons.detail: Basic surface stippling is present on nuclei, but cytoplasm textures lack fine fidelity.
reasons.science: Depicts an interlocking squamous sheet with particles, but missing the cross-sectional membrane view.
reasons.same_class: The rendering feels more like a standard educational model than cinematic macro realism.

route1.biggest_gap: The cellular material lacks wetness and translucent subsurface scattering, resulting in an opaque, rubbery appearance.
